name: r4_SlotClearAll
notes: no register inputs (or edx -1 is a constant load); clears the 18 work slots at 0x00400E50

name: r4_SlotRelease
notes: stack args; loop strength reduction: original walks a pointer to slot+4 with a signed end compare and modern cl walks the slot base with an unsigned end compare (same array same bound)

name: r4_SlotInitType2
notes: regargs: s=EDI; float constants 0.7 and -500.0 stored as immediates by modern cl instead of .rdata loads

name: r4_SlotInitType0
notes: regargs: s=ESI; float constants -9.0 1.0 2.5 stored as immediates by modern cl instead of .rdata loads; store merging of the two zero words at +0x80/+0x82

name: r4_SlotAttach
notes: stack args; calls 0x00196790 with ESI=slot and 0x001953B0 0x00196850 0x001968A0 with EDI=slot; loop strength reduction (pointer to slot+4 signed end vs slot base unsigned end); 1.0f immediate store; modern cl builds the return value 1 as type-2 / type-3 after the type tests (constant materialisation)

name: r4_FogInit
notes: stack args; float constants stored as immediates by modern cl instead of .rdata loads

name: r4_MatCopyRotation
notes: stack args; float constants stored as immediates by modern cl instead of .rdata loads

name: r4_RunPasses
notes: stack args; calls 0x001B2270 with a normal stack arg

name: r4_MatBuildW1
notes: stack args; float constants stored as immediates by modern cl instead of .rdata loads

name: r4_PoolAlloc
notes: regargs: pool=ECX (no stack args); returns the item in EAX

name: r4_EmitSetReset
notes: stack arg (mov edi edi filler is not a register read); loop strength reduction: modern cl biases the item pointer by +0xCC and indexes the count field at -0x60

name: r4_TexFindByKey
notes: regargs: group=ESI (low 16 bits) key=ECX; result index in EAX (division by the 0x58 record size)

name: r4_TexFindByName
notes: stack args (group name); unsigned bounds check: the 'a'..'z' test is folded to (c-0x61)<=0x19 and -0x20 is encoded as a dword by modern cl

name: r4_HeapClearUsed
notes: no inputs; loop strength reduction (pointer biased by the +8 field)

name: r4_HeapRunCost
notes: regargs: b=EDX size=ECX (low 16 bits) code=EBX (BL); result in EAX

name: r4_HeapKindCode
notes: regargs: kind=EAX (low 16 bits); result in AL

name: r4_HeapFindBlock
notes: regargs: addr=EDX (low 16 bits); result in EAX; signed vs unsigned compare of two zero-extended 16-bit sums (modern cl uses ja for the original jg)

name: r4_Heap2Reset
notes: no inputs; loop strength reduction (pointer biased by the +0x10 field so the +4 byte is reached at -0xC)

name: r4_Heap2Merge
notes: no inputs (mov edi edi filler is not a register read)

name: r4_HeapFindFit
notes: regargs: code=EAX (AL) first=ECX size=stack; calls 0x001BB030 with EDX=block ECX=size EBX=code; result in AX

name: r4_HeapAlloc
notes: stack args (size kind); calls 0x001BB0B0 with EAX=kind; 0x001BB3E0 with EAX=code ECX=first block and size on the stack; 0x001BB440 with EAX=size EDX=addr and (code 0) on the stack

name: r4_HeapClaim
notes: stack args (addr size kind); calls 0x001BB0B0 with EAX=kind and 0x001BB440 with EAX=size EDX=addr and (code 1) on the stack

name: r4_Heap2Init
notes: no inputs; store merging of the +4/+5 byte stores

name: r4_TexFindNamed
notes: stack arg; calls 0x001B9BF0 with normal stack args

name: r4_DevicesInit
notes: no register inputs (or eax -1 is a constant load); calls XDK 0x001D1B80 (stdcall two args) per slot

name: r4_ThreadSetState
notes: regargs: id=EAX state=stack; result in EAX

name: r4_SkinBoneMask
notes: stack arg (mov edi edi filler is not a register read)

name: r4_SkinReset
notes: regargs: s=EAX; loop strength reduction: original stores through a pointer biased by +0xD0 and advances it after the stores while modern cl advances it before the stores

name: r4_ThreadExit
notes: no inputs; calls 0x001AD340 with EAX=current thread id (XDK 0x001BD50A) and state 1 on the stack; XDK 0x001BD345 does not return

name: r4_EmitIsDone
notes: stack arg; unsigned loop end: the zero-count test on the unsigned count is jbe in the original and je in modern cl
